entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
I can certainly help you with that. To pull up your account, could I please get your name and order number?
Thank you, Sarah. I see your order for the VeloPro Road Cycling Shoes, delivered 43 days ago. What specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
They don't fit. I've tried everything, even adjusting the cleats a dozen times, and they just give me terrible blisters. So, preference, I guess.
I'm sorry to hear they're causing blisters; that's definitely not the experience we want for our riders. Let me just check our return policy for you. One moment.

Okay, thank you for waiting. I see here that these cycling shoes are well within our 90-day return window. I can absolutely process a full refund for you. I'll email a pre-paid return label to you right now.

The label is on its way to your email. And Sarah, I see you're one of our VIP members. I'm really sorry these didn't work out. As a thank you for your loyalty, I've added a credit for free expedited shipping to your account for your next order.
Oh. Well, I suppose that's something. Thanks.
You're very welcome. Once we receive the shoes back at our warehouse, your refund will be processed. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
